summary: Set image_pull_policy, image_pull_secrets, web/task/ee/redis/postgres resource requirements, postgres_storage_requirements and replicas under spec.controller in the AAP CR; with controller.name these update the existing instance.
questions: How do I set the controller image pull policy on OpenShift?
How do I add image_pull_secrets for automation controller?
Set task_resource_requirements for controller in the AAP CR

answer_card.title: Controller pull policy and resources
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
spec:
  controller:
    image_pull_policy: IfNotPresent   # Always, Never, IfNotPresent
    image_pull_secrets:
      - pull-secret-name
    task_resource_requirements:
      requests: {cpu: 1000m, memory: 2Gi}
      limits: {cpu: 2000m, memory: 4Gi}
    postgres_storage_requirements:
      requests: {storage: 8Gi}
    replicas: 1
```
